messages:
Anna (PM): drafting PRD for the next Redwood API iteration — focus: unified chat/completions + embeddings + rerank rollout. need input on scope tradeoffs and must-have acceptance criteria.
Mitul (Eng): +1. main infra questions: graceful degradation (fallbacks) and per-route SLAs. we should define exact behavior when primary model is overloaded.
Devon (Infra): propose policy: try primary model for 250ms, if not accepting new requests then route to fallback model; if fallback also overloaded return 503 with structured error. Also need observability hooks.
Olga (ML): for rerank: define deterministic tie-breaker and seed handling. embeddings: call out normalization differences (L2 vs none) across models.
Anna (PM): acceptance criteria draft (high level):
- functional: chat/completions API supports model variants + automatic fallback policy
- perf: p95 latency for chat (short inputs) < 200ms on hosted tier; p99 < 600ms
- correctness: rerank must be stable given same inputs 99.9% of the time
- consistency: embedding vectors normalized or documented; SDKs expose "normalize=true/false" flag
Mitul (Eng): add quota/rate-limit behavior for batch embeddings: partial successes allowed + explicit per-item status in response. example: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
Response: { "data": [{"status":"ok","embedding":[...]}, {"status":"failed","error":"timeout"}] }
```
Devon (Infra): agree. also need a clear contract for token accounting with streaming responses — customers care about billing determinism. we should document rounding rules (per-chunk vs final).
Carol (Docs): can we have example SDK snippets for common failure modes? eg retryable codes (429, 503), non-retryable (4xx param errors), and a snippet for client-side exponential backoff. I'll draft.
Olga (ML): edge-case list suggestion: 
- rerank ties: use deterministic secondary feature (timestamp/hash)
- embeddings drift between model versions: require "versioned embeddings" header and migration guide
- batch embedding partial compute (GPU OOM mid-batch) -> fallback to per-item CPU compute with higher latency, marked in response
Mitul (Eng): rollout plan: canary 2% for 24h -> 10% for 48h -> 50% -> 100%. automated rollback on quality/regression alerts (eval harness on a small prompt set). Also add traffic-based knob to route to Dedicated customers only.
Anna (PM): launch gating checklist (proposal):
- infra: fallback policy + observability + alerting
- perf: meet p95/p99 targets on synthetic and production shadow tests
- docs: migration guide + SDK examples + error contract
- compliance: audit logs for Private deployments enabled
- product: acceptance tests signed off by @Olga and @Mitul
Mitul (Eng): acceptance tests (concrete):
1) end-to-end chat flow with fallback engaged (simulate primary overloaded) -> client sees seamless response from fallback with a header `x-redwood-fallback: model-small`
2) embeddings: batch of 1000 with 10 induced failures -> 990 OK + 10 failed entries; SDK surfaces per-item status
3) rerank: 1000 deterministic runs -> no more than 1 mismatch per 10k runs
Devon (Infra): telemetry specifics: emit metrics: `redwood.route.latency.{p50,p95,p99}`, `redwood.fallback.count`, `redwood.batch.failure.rate`. also each fallback event should include route, customer_id, primary_model, fallback_model, and reason.
Anna (PM): edge-case discussion: what about model upgrades? can we do zero-downtime swap with compatibility checks?
Olga (ML): we need a compatibility matrix: embedding dims, tokenization changes, and rerank score distribution checks. upgrade should run shadow traffic for 48h and smoke checks for regressions on saved prompts.
Carol (Docs): I'll add a "breaking changes" subsection and an automated checklist for on-call before swap.
Mitul (Eng): small config example for per-route policy (sketch):
```
routes:
  - name: /v1/chat
    primary: redwood-chat-v3
    fallback: redwood-chat-v2
    timeout_ms: 250
    canary: {pct: 2, duration: 24h}
    sla: {p95: 200}
```
Anna (PM): owners & next steps:
- Mitul: flesh out fallback error contract + telemetry (due EOD Fri)
- Olga: provide regression harness and acceptance prompt set (due Tue)
- Carol: docs + SDK examples (first pass Mon)
- Devon: rollout automation + metrics dashboards (due Wed)
rollout-bot: created PRD issue #4021 under product/roadmap (link: https://tasks.redwood/prod/4021) :thumbsup:
Mitul (Eng): noted. one more callout: make sure Dedicated customers can opt-out of fallback to smaller models (data residency / quality reasons). test case needed.
Anna (PM): good point — add an "opt_out_fallback" flag per customer. will include in PRD.
Devon (Infra): last: add synthetic canary that hits rerank/embeddings daily to detect silent regressions. automated rollback on anomaly.
Olga (ML): I'm pairing with Mitul on the harness tomorrow.
Anna (PM): thanks everyone. I'll merge this into the PRD draft and ping for final review.
Carol (Docs): ack, will watch PRD thread and start doc skeleton.
rollout-bot: PRD #4021 updated: tags=canary,fallback,embeddings,rerank
Anna (PM): leaving this thread open for anything else but will close when PRD merged."
